meta.note: Trees as [x, z, kind, surveyed] (surveyed 1 = an SDOT street tree or OpenStreetMap tree, 0 = synthesised). kind: street = deciduous street trees (maples, oaks, elms, sweetgum, linden, zelkova, cherry: 8-15 m, rounded crowns, in pits or planting strips); plane = London plane (Platanus, 18-25 m, broad, mottled bark: the big downtown avenue trees); evergreen = Pacific Northwest conifers (Douglas fir, western red cedar, pines, incense cedar: 15-30 m, dark narrow cones - the PNW look); park = mixed park trees (in lawns and the wooded parks: Freeway Park, Denny Park, the Olympic Sculpture Park; synthesised on a jittered 4.2 u grid where OSM maps none, 45% of those evergreen). Trees closer than 1 u to another were dropped. Trees inside the ring venue box (ring.ringClearTrees in seattle_layout.json) are left out.
